title: The Four Regions of the Serengeti Explained
excerpt: The Serengeti is not one place. Central, southern, western and northern Serengeti each have their own landscape and best season.
body:
Because the Serengeti is so big, choosing the right area is one of the key decisions for your safari.

## Central Serengeti (Seronera)

Open plains, rocky outcrops called kopjes and the Seronera River. Resident wildlife all year round and famous for big cats. The best all-round area. See [Seronera](/blog/seronera-central-serengeti/).

## Southern Serengeti (Ndutu)

Short-grass plains where the migration herds give birth from roughly January to March. Many predators. Partly in the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. See [Ndutu and the calving season](/blog/ndutu-calving-season/).

## Western Corridor (Grumeti)

A long strip towards Lake Victoria, with the Grumeti River and its large crocodiles. Herds usually pass through around May to July. See [the Western Corridor](/blog/western-corridor-grumeti/).

## Northern Serengeti (Kogatende, Lamai)

Hilly and remote, with the Mara River. From around July to October this is where the dramatic river crossings take place. See [the northern Serengeti](/blog/northern-serengeti-kogatende/).

## Eastern Serengeti

Less visited plains and kopjes, such as the Gol Kopjes and Namiri Plains area, known for cheetahs.

## How to choose

Combine central Serengeti with the region where the migration is during your travel dates. [Tell us your dates](/travel-proposal/) and we will suggest the best combination.
